'''Ruu San''' was a deadly [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Special Operations|Special Operations]]. As part of the organization, her role entailed protecting the secrecy of [[Dark Trooper Project|Operation Dark Trooper]] at all costs<ref name="Revving Up" /> around the time of the destruction of the Empire's [[Death Star/Legends|first Death Star]] at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="Dark Forces">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''</ref> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' notes that the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] takes place in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> As part of her mission, she faced<ref name="Revving Up" /> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent [[Kyle Katarn]] who was investigating the project.<ref name="Dark Forces" /> San was cunning and eminently capable in her role.<ref name="Revving Up" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ruu San was meant to appear in the [[1995]] [[Star Wars video games|computer game]] ''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]'', and so was briefly described as an antagonist and equal of [[Kyle Katarn]] in the article "[[Game Room|Revving Up the 'Jedi Engine']]" in [[Star Wars Galaxy Magazine 1|''Star Wars Galaxy Magazine'' 1]], published in [[October]], [[1994]].<ref name="Revving Up" /> However, she did not appear in the final release of the game.<ref name="Dark Forces" />
